notes.manas-2010:p1369:b001:l001: Plural combatants Almambet and Chubak continue1368:40–42; no new speaker before Manas speech10.
notes.manas-2010:p1369:b001:l015: Burut historical designation of Kyrgyz retained; palm-size metaphor describes small people against world, not physical stature.
notes.manas-2010:p1369:b001:l022: Printed self-comparison to dug dark grave retained, not rewritten as I will enter my grave.
notes.manas-2010:p1369:b001:l024: Exact Yudakhin ээрдин кесе тиштенип = bite lip until blood, https://el-sozduk.kg/kes-/; no hypothetical saddle reading or source emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p1369:b001:l033: Blood draining from flesh may indicate fear/pallor or fury; physical description retained without resolving emotion against angry charge.
notes.manas-2010:p1369:b001:l038: күн күркүрөө thunder, sky/weather contextual sense of күн, not literally sun making noise; Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/гром/.
notes.manas-2010:p1370:b001:l005: муштап understood weapon thrust, confirmed next8–10 both spear him, not introduced fist attack.
notes.manas-2010:p1370:b001:l021: Gray bull is Madykan mount; Manas rides Akkula19 and knocks Madykan from bull. Word order adjusted with nextline to prevent falsely putting Manas on bull.
notes.manas-2010:p1370:b001:l026: Printed аттан horse retained though preceding mount explicitly bull. Formula inconsistency not silently harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p1370:b001:l030: Kongurbay anticipates Beijing khan death, not confirmation before Bakai beheading nextpage.
notes.manas-2010:p1370:b001:l039: мөндү translated Come per edition1841:4–6; all three repetitions preserved and repeated verb nextline rendered battle cry.
notes.manas-2010:p1371:b001:l003: Hungry/ravenous steel sword epithet retained rather than adding a proper weapon name.
notes.manas-2010:p1371:b001:l009: зор force/greater host construed with following mass arrival; could introduce specifically mightier warrior. Comparative thousandfold retained without invented headcount.
notes.manas-2010:p1371:b001:l015: казыналык treasury/state-service epithet literal treasury marksman, not a treasure hunter.
notes.manas-2010:p1371:b001:l016: аяр sorcerer, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/аяр/; title translated, not unexplained common-word transliteration.
notes.manas-2010:p1371:b001:l017: Каканчын emperor/Chinese imperial realm, locative rendered realm; no new named character inserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1371:b001:l025: Чоң Аяр translated Great Sorcerer, named epithet not separate ordinary Ayar personal identity; source calls him this.
notes.manas-2010:p1371:b001:l032: Six thousand perished while six remained explicitly repeated source epic total; not adjusted to5994.
notes.manas-2010:p1371:b001:l035: Elliptical genitive Алмамбеттин with following shortfall understood other marksman three months behind Almambet. This agrees next38–40 conditional equality; not harmonized to other accounts where marksman studied longer.
